label: single host, public weights, warm cache, no fleet claim; codec-level per-tensor frames, not the store planner; consecutive training checkpoints and the independent fine-tune are reported separately
method: per tensor: the exact base tensor bytes are encoded as a mode-6 TENSOR frame; mode 11 and mode 16 are encoded against that frame and both decoded, and each decode is compared against the original bytes and against the other mode. Encode wall time is one measurement per mode per tensor. Decode time is the median of five repetitions of parse+decode. zstd -19 bytes and decode medians come from the target checkpoint's existing P2 tensors phase; they are not re-measured. Totals are sums over the tensors of one pair and are never combined across pair kinds.
